nbtac.options.field.short_boolean.desc: Suggests 1b/0b instead of true/false for boolean value. Note that it doesn't apply to raw JSON format, as it requires true/false form.
Puts tag names in quotation marks.
true - Always
false - When necessary
nbtac.options.field.string_quotation_mar:
Puts values of string type in quotation marks.
true - Always
false - When necessary
nbtac.options.field.default_quotation_ma:
Defines what kind of quotation mark will be used by default.
single - [']
double - ["]
If you're on 1.21.4 or older note that it doesn't apply to JSON text components.
nbtac.options.field.json_string_suggesti:
Defines simple string opening suggestion for JSON text components.
none - None
default_for_strings - uses quote type from "Default Quotation Mark Type" setting.
legacy_separated - [' "]
legacy_merged - ['"] - similar to legacy_separated, but without space.
legacy_backslash - ["\"].
nbtac.options.field.ignore_letter_case.d: Ignores letter case when providing tag name suggestions.
nbtac.options.field.show_tag_hints.desc: Shows tag hints (like its type or source) next to its name in a suggestion list.
nbtac.options.field.custom_sorting.desc: Allows the mod to use non-alphabetical suggestion sorting.
nbtac.options.field.mark_recommended.des: Marks recommended suggestions with "<*>" in a hint.
nbtac.options.field.recommended_at_the_t: Places recommended suggestions at the top of the list. Requires custom sorting.
nbtac.options.field.mark_irrelevant.desc: Marks irrelevant suggestions with "<I>" in a hint.
nbtac.options.field.placing_of_irrelevan:
Specifies the placing of irrelevant suggestions.
Possible values: normal, at_the_bottom, hidden
Values other than "normal" require custom sorting to be enabled.
nbtac.options.field.hide_mc_namespace_in: Hides "minecraft:" namespace from item component suggestions.
nbtac.options.field.show_custom_data_as_: When enabled it will always show "minecraft:custom_data" item component as relevant suggestion. When disabled it will always be shown as irrelevant.
nbtac.options.field.show_custom_model_da: When enabled it will always show "minecraft:custom_model_data" item component as relevant suggestion. When disabled it will always be shown as irrelevant.
Specifies the method vanilla IDs (in "minecraft:" namespace) are sorted in relation to non-vanilla IDs (from mods). It applies only to suggestions provided by NBT Autocomplete. This setting is also strongly related to "Hide Minecraft Namespace In Strings" setting.
0 - Without Custom Sorting - with hidden vanilla namespace it will cause IDs to be scattered around IDs from mods, therefore it isn't recommended.
1 - Depends - placed at the top only with namespace hidden, otherwise in the middle.
2 - Always At The Top
3 - Always In The Middle
Other values will be treated as 1.
nbtac.options.field.unknown_item_compone:
Specifies default relevancy of unknown item data components.
This applies mainly to modded components. If you see unknown item components
in vanilla (with only NBTac installed), report this as an issue.
relevant_by_default - unknown item components are marked as relevant by default.
relevant_within_namespace - unknown item components are marked as relevant only if their ID is in the same namespace as item ID.
irrelevant_by_default - unknown item components are marked as irrelevant by default.
nbtac.options.field.support_command_name: Ignores the "minecraft:" as command prefix. Useful when using with plugins which put Minecraft commands under this namespace.
nbtac.options.field.use_new_thread.desc: Uses new thread to load suggestions during Minecraft loading.
nbtac.options.field.debug_mode.desc: Enables additional messages and checks useful for debugging.
nbtac.options.field.debug_sleep.desc: Delays suggestion loading to better measure time it takes (value in milliseconds, recommended to set to a few thousand).
Shows settings GUI after exiting realms screen. It isn't reset to default value by GUI reset button!
nbtac.options.common.gui_debug_warning: Config screen debug mode is enabled!
